errors.evidence: Description states 'approximately around two thirds to three quarters' for 'Virtual Characters' but the figure visually represents it as much less.
Description states 'one tenth' for 'Custom Characters,' but it appears to occupy a larger visual area.
'Real Characters' is described as occupying 'approximately one fifth,' which visually is incorrect as it appears larger.
'Comic Characters' is incorrectly described as 'approximately one third' when it occupies less space than indicated.
Description fails to mention that the pie chart represents categories and subcategories within the context of role-playing characters.
'Custom Characters' is mentioned but not accurately represented in terms of its significance in the chart.
The description states 'Virtual Characters' occupy two-thirds of the circle, but it visually occupies less than half.
'Custom Characters' is described as being between one-fifth to one-quarter, while it visually represents a much smaller portion than one-fifth.
'Real Characters' is stated to be around one-eighth to one-sixth, while it occupies more than one-sixth of the inner ring.
'Comic Characters' is described as occupying roughly a quarter to a third, whereas it visually covers a smaller area than a quarter.
'Game Characters' is reported to be about the mid-teens; however, it visually appears to be more significant than that.
The colors assigned are not clearly articulated, as the inner colors are described but lack specific references to the visual clarity.
The phrases 'roughly about' and 'around' create vagueness in the description, making it less precise.
Description says 'Virtual Characters' is about two-thirds of the circle, but it visually occupies a smaller area.
Description states 'Real Characters' is approximately one-fifth of the circle, but it is larger than that.
Description claims 'Custom Characters' is about one-sixth of the circle; it visually occupies a larger area.
Description does not specify the exact distribution of the 13 subcategories.
'Comic Characters' is mentioned as the largest segment, but 'Custom Characters' does not have subcategories and is inaccurately described.
Phrasing like 'groß, grob etwa' can be clearer; overuse of approximations may confuse readers.
